HOW GFP ANSWERS

A small edit is not a small result.

01

The request meets the building

Every prompt is read against the current, confirmed state of your project. Most of what the answer needs is already there.

02

The missing few

GFP gathers only what this request still needs: from you, a site document, a code, or a calculation. Never from a guess. A value taken from a standard stays visible as provisional.

03

You confirm

The change is read back in floors and metres. Nothing is built until you say yes.

04

The engine rebuilds

Not the edit: the whole building, to the last bolt, in minutes. The engine calculates. It does not guess.

05

The building talks back

A rebuilt building can raise a question that did not exist before: a panel now too wide, a mullion no longer over the one below, a drainage path cut. It returns as one precise question.

06

A coordinated answer

Geometry, glass, mullions, loads, brackets, quantities, drawings, assembly order: one new, coordinated version of the facade. The picture is one view of it.

07

The project remembers

The confirmed state carries forward. The next request draws its own boundary: what the building already knows, and what it must still learn.

TECHNOLOGY

AI grounded in a construction system.

General AI can describe a facade. GFP generates a coordinated one. It converts a building brief into construction operations, resolves the curtain wall and keeps every measurable result connected as the design changes.

Knowing that wind exists and carrying it through every element of a specific facade are different abilities.

01 · ARCHITECTURE

The building logic.

Standard and custom floor heights, slabs, ceiling voids, raised floors, podium-to-tower relationships and setbacks.

02 · CURTAIN WALL

The parts that make it real.

Measurable mullions, transoms and glass panels; vision and spandrel zones; internal and external corners; drainage at junctions.

03 · RATIONALISATION

Every panel is accountable.

Each glass panel is identified, measured, counted and grouped. The engine rationalises panel sizes and calculates glass, aluminium and silicone quantities.

04 · ENGINEERING

Loads remain linked to design.

Wind pressure is resolved across every facade and feeds field loads, glass checks, deflection and profile-property logic.

Depth before breadth

The public engine begins with aluminium stick curtain walls so the construction logic can be complete, measurable and useful. The same architecture can expand into contractor and manufacturer systems as their catalogues, products and rules are encoded.

Working today

Build and revise a stick curtain wall from a prompt; resolve floors, grids, glass, corners, setbacks and drainage; calculate quantities and wind; and produce elevations, plans, sections and visualisations from one live building state.
